headline: Discord now runs natively on Meta Quest headsets
summary: Native Discord app available on Meta Quest
details: The native app for Discord is now available on Meta Quest headsets, following an announcement at last year's Meta Connect conference. This native integration allows users to access their Discord servers, direct messages, and calls directly from their VR headsets.

The Meta Quest app for Discord offers enhanced features such as automatically using the VR headset's built-in mic for calls and allowing the Discord interface to remain pinned within the play space while in-game. Users can also stream gameplay directly to Discord from the Meta Quest and join Discord calls with their Meta avatar.

Previously, some users found workarounds to access Discord on their VR headsets, but the native app provides a more seamless experience. The app supports all the usual Discord features, including access to the same servers, DMs, and calls as other versions.
caption:
Can you game and chat on Meta Quest now?

The native app for Discord is now available on Meta Quest headsets, following an announcement at last year's Meta Connect conference. This native integration allows users to access their Discord servers, direct messages, and calls directly from their VR headsets.

Users can also stream gameplay directly to Discord from the Meta Quest and join Discord calls with their Meta avatar.

Previously, some users found workarounds to access Discord on their VR headsets, but the native app provides a more seamless experience. The app supports all the usual Discord features, including access to the same servers, DMs, and calls as other versions.
